title: Analytics Director
description: <p><strong>WHO ARE WE:</strong></p><p>We are Mediahub, the industry’s best kept secret. This year we got our first Campaign School Report, coming in at number one for building the most ethnically diverse team in the industry. COMvergence rank us as the UK's fastest growing media agency for the second year running.</p><p>We bring a challenger mindset to everything we do. Brands choose to work with us to disrupt category norms.</p><p>We offer the best of both worlds. A start-up culture backed by Mediabrands.</p><p>Just some of the brands we work with – New Balance, Pinterest, Celebrity Cruises, Activision, Esprit, Bicester Collection.</p><p>You will be joining an agency that is for everyone.</p><p><br></p><p>We live by our values:</p><ul><li><strong>Anticipate tomorrow</strong> - we are challengers, we are proactive in thinking about what needs to happen today in order to make tomorrow better</li><li><strong>Hustle from the heart</strong> - we move fast, take ownership, and look out for each other</li><li><strong>Perform with pride</strong> - we take pride and care in what we do, and we strive for excellence</li><li><strong>Believe you can</strong> - believe in yourself to make a difference; believe in each other to do great things</li><li><strong>Stay curious</strong> - we have fun on the journey of discovery</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p><p>As the Analytics Director, you will lead and oversee the analytics function for our clients on a global scale. Your role will involve managing the delivery of everything from Dashboards to advanced analytics projects, collaborating with Media teams, data science and engineering teams, and driving innovation in data solutions. You will ensure that analytics outputs align with business objectives and deliver measurable value to clients. This position requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of analytics and its application within the business context.</p><p>We seek a passionate, ambitious, and curious leader who thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The ideal candidate will have a strategic mindset, strong business acumen, and the ability to innovate and drive change within the analytics function. You should be committed to delivering exceptional client service and be ready to take on new challenges that push the boundaries of traditional analytics.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Manage a team of analysts, providing guidance, mentoring, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality analytics outputs across key projects.</li><li><strong>Project Management:</strong> Oversee the specification and delivery of critical analytics projects, ensuring they meet client requirements and deadlines. Work closely with Lead Analysts to maintain project alignment with business objectives.</li><li><strong>Client Relationship Management:</strong> Act as a key point of contact for clients, working alongside the Group Analytics Director to nurture and expand client relationships. Own the analytics output for assigned accounts and campaigns.</li><li><strong>Test and Learn Programmes:</strong> Deploy and oversee test and learn programmes, ensuring they deliver demonstrable incremental value for clients through initiatives such as onsite conversion rate optimisation (CRO) and digital ad platform enhancements.</li><li><strong>Data Solutions Development:</strong> Collaborate with Engineering and Data Science teams to advance data solutions, including econometrics, investment planning, clustering, and modelling.</li><li><strong>Innovation in Analytics:</strong> Contribute to shaping the organisation’s data analytics offering by exploring and applying new techniques in marketing, consumer research, predictive analytics, and machine learning.</li><li><strong>Stakeholder Communication:</strong> Serve as a bridge between client business users and the data engineering team, ensuring clear communication and understanding of analytics findings and recommendations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Desired Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Experience:</strong> Significant years of relevant experience, preferably in managing the delivery of complex analytics projects within a global brand or agency environment.</li><li><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Proficiency in SQL databases and dashboarding software such as Power BI or Tableau is important. Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or R and their associated data analysis libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn) is a plus.</li><li><strong>Statistical Expertise:</strong> Strong understanding of statistics, including descriptive statistics, regression, probability, sampling, and hypothesis testing.</li><li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written and verbal presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into actionable business insights for non-technical audiences.</li><li><strong>Domain Knowledge:</strong> Good understanding of the media industry and the ability to balance brand and performance media investment allocations effectively</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Employee Transparency</strong></p><p>At IPG Mediabrands, we celebrate differences and believe this makes us stronger. IPG Mediabrands are equal-opportunity employers committed to championing an inclusive culture that provides a sense of belonging for all our employees. We do not discriminate against any applicant based on age, disability, race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, belief, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law.</p><p><br></p><p>Please reach out to our Talent Inclusion Specialist Jess at Jess.Richardson@mbww.com if you would like to have a confidential conversation regarding any adjustments that would ensure our recruitment process is accessible for you. Please note requesting a reasonable adjustment will not affect your application.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The Perks</strong></p><p>We aim to provide all our people with a supportive and fun work environment where you can develop your full potential and benefit from the broad range of opportunities within the agency. When you join us, we want to make sure you feel valued – and that you are rewarded for your fantastic work. So, we also offer a range of benefits:</p><ul><li>Flexi–leave, with 25 days annual leave to be taken as minimum. In addition to your holiday entitlement, the office usually closes between Christmas &amp; New Year</li><li>Free breakfast and free lunch</li><li>Early finish Fridays</li><li>Core Hours (Mon-Thurs, flexible start/finish times)</li><li>Retail discounts</li><li>Wellbeing programme</li><li>Interest free season ticket loan</li><li>Paid time off for Volunteering</li><li>Group Income Protection</li><li>Life Assurance</li><li>Private Medical Insurance or Health Cash Plan (dependent on level)</li><li>Group Personal Pension Plan with matched contributions from 3-6%</li><li>Generous Parental Leave &amp; Pay</li><li>Independent mortgage advice</li><li>Financial education</li><li>Employee Assistance Programme</li><li>Free eye tests</li><li>Flexible benefits including Dental, Travel insurance, Cycle to Work, Gym Discounts and many more!</li></ul>

title: Power & Utilities Associate Director - Finance - WACC
description: <strong>Job details<br><br></strong><strong>Location: </strong>London<br><br><strong>Capability: </strong>Advisory<br><br><strong>Experience Level: </strong>Senior Manager<br><br><strong>Type: </strong>Full Time or Part Time<br><br><strong>Service Line: </strong>Customer, Ops &amp; Infr<br><br><strong>Contract type: </strong>Permanent<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong><strong>The Team<br><br></strong>KPMG’s Infrastructure Team in the UK consists of c400 professionals and is widely recognised as one of the world’s leading independent financial and business advisers in infrastructure.<br><br>We provide in-depth advice on the strategic, financial, regulatory and commercial issues driving investments in infrastructure across Transport, Power &amp; Utilities, and Social Infrastructure in the UK and internationally. Our work includes market and policy design, economic analysis, deal structuring and execution, as well as strategic and transaction advice to enable private and public capital to fund infrastructure. We also work closely with other functions within KPMG to advise clients on mergers and acquisitions, valuations, tax, accounting, and due diligence.<br><br>The utilities sector is a key business area for the Infrastructure Team and encompasses work for the large clients in the sector including all of the leading UK energy and water companies. We provide in depth strategic and technical advice on corporate finance issues, corporate financial management; regulatory finance, regulatory policy, business and financial planning, as well as other issues affecting value. We are widely recognised by many industry stakeholders as one of the most innovative advisors influencing the future of the sector.<br><br>Our business is continuously expanding and we are looking for high quality candidates to support our Power &amp; Utilities business with a particular focus on financial and economic analysis, including cost of capital estimation, financeability assessments, risk and scenario analysis, financial modelling, investment appraisal &amp; valuation.<br><br><strong>The Role<br><br></strong><ul><li>You would be joining the leading provider of regulatory finance consultancy services in the utilities sector.</li><li>While you will have specific responsibilities for contributing towards the team’s regulatory finance business in utilities, there will also be opportunities to work in other sectors.</li><li>Working closely with the director for finance in the utilities sector, you will help lead and further develop the team, increasing our presence in the sector.</li><li>This will include identifying new opportunities, contributing towards winning work, and coaching junior members of staff.</li><li>You will build relationships with key clients across the sector, as well as with other advisors (e.g. legal and engineering).</li><li>The projects that you will advise on will be high profile and varied. For example, in recent years we have advised on cost of capital, financeability, risk analysis, financing strategy, financial modelling, state aid, Competition and Markets Authority re-determinations, major transactions and much more.</li><li>There is no ‘typical project’. You will need to apply a structured strategic approach to problem solving, drawing on established economic and corporate finance principles, while having the capacity to think creatively.</li><li>You will be leading the delivery of key projects. This will include delegating tasks to team members, constructing project plans, managing client interactions, tracking budgets, and complying with the company’s risk processes.</li><li>You will need to be comfortable managing, coaching, and mentoring junior staff on specific projects.</li><li>You will maintain a good understanding of regulatory finance issues in the regulated sectors e.g. on setting the cost of capital or assessing financeability, as well as how regulatory mechanisms interact with or impact the actual financing of regulated businesses<br><br><br></li></ul><strong> The Person<br><br></strong><ul><li>Educated to a degree level in a quantitative field such as Finance, Economics, Mathematics or similar will be preferred, although candidates with highly relevant, equivalent experience, will also be considered</li><li>Have significant experience in the utilities sector, either as a regulatory policy maker (gained at a regulatory office or industry) or as a consultant specialising in regulatory or corporate finance, with specific expertise in WACC estimation and the application of the Capital Asset Pricing Model</li><li>Have a detailed knowledge of the current UK regulatory regimes and regulatory finance mechanics for utilities, their application and impact on notional and actual capital structures and business performance, including the role of the WACC in allowed revenue estimation</li><li>Demonstrate strong working knowledge of economic and financial theory and its application – for example risk-return trade-offs, fixed income pricing and valuation, capital structure, asset pricing, and beta estimation – preferably with experience in applying corporate finance concepts in the regulated networks space</li><li>Be highly skilled in quantitative economic and financial analysis. The ideal candidate will have experience leading projects with extensive WACC analysis elements, and /or have detailed knowledge and experience of financial econometrics and statistics, ideally applied in the utilities sectors</li><li>Have a sound knowledge of finances and financial structures of regulated utilities and their treatment within the regulatory WACC framework (we will consider candidates with deep expertise in financial analysis even if they do not have econometrics experience)</li><li>Provide compelling and well-thought out solutions to complex economic and financial problems, being able to provide persuasive and self-assured responses in a credible manner</li><li>Bring excellent quantitative analysis (Stata or equivalent), Excel and Powerpoint skills</li><li>Bring exceptional written communication skills, with a proven ability to produce high-quality, technically rigorous reports for expert audiences, including regulators, investors, and legal advisors. Must be able to structure complex arguments clearly, present quantitative evidence effectively, and draft content suitable for scrutiny in formal regulatory or dispute resolution contexts</li><li>Be comfortable and experienced in an external facing role and in presenting to clients</li><li>Be an independent thinker with the ability to identify problems and contribute to the development of solutions, helping us to remain at the cutting edge of innovative thinking in the sector</li><li>Relish the opportunity for interaction and dialogue with companies, investors, regulators and other stakeholders, and with a host of functions across KPMG</li><li>Have experience of managing medium size project teams, with a focus on mentoring and coaching junior staff (with or without a finance background)</li><li>Be a proven team player who can demonstrate a clear desire to manage teams, who can gain the trust and support of internal colleagues</li><li>All UK staff who have not passed a Financial Services Authority (FSA) approved exam will be required to do so.<br><br><br></li></ul><strong> A final word from us… <br><br></strong>Everybody likes to say they’re different... but we really think we are.<br><br>We’re hugely proud of what we’ve managed to achieve so far, but we’re only just getting started. We’re looking for people to grow with us and are committed to helping everybody reach their destination, regardless of what that is.<br><br>Should you choose to join us, you can expect an attractive benefits package, which typically includes:<br><br>Financial<br><br><ul><li> A competitive salary </li><li> Pension options </li><li> Bonus scheme that reflects firm and individual performance </li><li> Rail and Oyster Card reimbursement </li><li> Staff discounts </li><li> Access to preferential banking <br><br><br></li></ul>Lifestyle<br><br><ul><li> 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to an extra 10 days, plus an additional day of leave for your birthday </li><li> Competitive maternity and paternity leave </li><li> 6 days of work time each year for volunteering </li><li> Daily lunch allowance </li><li> Flextra – a flexible benefits scheme that allows you to choose benefits for you and your family, such as, travel insurance, critical illness insurance, dental insurance and discounted gym memberships <br><br><br></li></ul>Health and Wellbeing<br><br><ul><li> Private medical insurance </li><li> Personal accident insurance </li><li> Life assurance of 4 x salary with the option to increase this via flexible benefits scheme </li><li> Access to private, remote GP appointments anytime and anywhere via a smartphone </li><li> Online health risk questionnaire </li><li> BeWell employee assistance programme for confidential information, advice, or counselling for life’s daily challenges </li><li> Group Income Protection <br><br><br></li></ul>No matter what skills you bring to our team, you’ll be surrounded by spirited, naturally curious people. People who want to learn from you, and who’ll also teach you a thing or two along the way. It’s how we make a collective impact, greater than the sum of its parts.<br><br>And if this isn’t the role for you but you like what you see, keep in touch. There will be other opportunities to join us.<br><br>For more details about a career at KPMG, visit:

title: Director, Product Management (AI Search)
description: At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 17,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.<br><br>In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.<br><br><strong>The Mission<br><br></strong>Empower developers and business users with the tools to maximize their use of Algolia’s Search platform. Our team builds advanced analytics, debugging tools, and applications that enhance keyword search capabilities, helping customers make data-driven decisions.<br><br><strong>The Opportunity<br><br></strong>The Search team at Algolia runs the world’s fastest and most relevant search engine. We operate one platform that covers ALL retrieval methods - keyword, semantic, db, and others. We eat, breathe, and sleep highly available and highly reliable services (4 9s is our minimum threshold). We build products that enable anyone to easily connect any data source and retrieve and collate content across multiple data sources. We inform our customers how best to optimize their discovery engines through automation and products. We run both the public cloud and our own bare metal because we demand the best performance. And, we are just getting started.<br><br><strong>The Team<br><br></strong>Our AI Search team is a remote-first, multicultural group committed to innovation and inclusion. We focus on three key areas of search: Understanding, Ranking, and Retrieval. We are looking for a Product Leader to drive the long-term vision and execution of AI Search.<br><br><strong>Your Role<br><br></strong>As a <strong>Director of Product for AI Search</strong>, you will:<br><br><ul><li>Define and communicate the strategy, vision, and roadmap for AI Search, working closely with the Executive Leadership Team.</li><li>Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, search trends, and emerging technologies to guide product direction.</li><li>Align closely with go-to-market teams to drive feature adoption and continuously refine our offerings based on customer feedback.</li><li>Partner with engineering and machine learning teams to develop technical product specifications and integrations.</li><li>Foster a culture of agility and innovation, promoting rapid prototyping and iterative learning.</li><li>Assess product development progress, identify enhancement opportunities, and ensure continuous improvement.</li><li>Manage budgets, forecasts, and key performance metrics.</li><li>Identify market trends, competitive positioning, and potential strategic partnerships.</li><li>Build and lead a world-class team of product managers.<br><br></li></ul><strong>You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have<br><br></strong><ul><li>Proven experience in technical B2B product management, preferably in AI, search, or API-driven platforms.</li><li>Leadership experience managing and scaling product management teams.</li><li>A track record of successfully shipping and iterating on products in an agile development environment.</li><li>The ability to translate complex technical challenges into strategic business solutions.</li><li>Experience engaging with high-profile customers, including presenting roadmaps and gathering feedback.</li><li>Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.</li><li>Hands-on expertise with search engines, real-time APIs, and AI/ML-powered products.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Flexible Workplace Strategy<br><br></strong>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.<br><br>We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees.<strong> Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.<br><br></strong><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:<br><br></strong><ul><li>GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.</li><li>TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.</li><li>CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.</li><li>CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.</li><li>HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.<br><br></li></ul>We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.<br><br><strong>PLEASE REVIEW OUR POLICY FOR AI USE IN INTERVIEWS</strong> - https://www.algolia.com/blog/algolia/algolia-ai-guidelines-for-candidates<br><br><strong>IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice<br><br></strong>We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Targeting Job Seekers. To Help Protect Yourself, Please Keep The Following In Mind<br><br><ul><li>Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.</li><li>All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.</li><li>We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.<br><br></li></ul><strong>READY TO APPLY?<br><br></strong>If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search &amp; discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!<br><br>

title: Senior Technical Services and Ongoing Support Manager, Digital Technologies
description: At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.<br><br><strong>A Day in the Life<br><br></strong>Digital Technologies is Medtronic’s Business Unit implementing cutting-edge AI technology, computer vision, and augmented reality to the operating room (OR) and surgical training. Our goal is to deliver safer surgery around the world. Our Touch Surgery Ecosystem includes an innovative video management and data analytics platform for hospitals that includes the DS1 computer, our first OR device, allowing surgeons, OR team members, and trainees to securely access videos of their procedures shortly after surgery. The device uses advanced AI algorithms that enable automatic processing and uploading of videos. Our surgical training platform is the award-winning Touch Surgery application that provides safe and accessible training for surgeons and other healthcare professionals. <br><br>As we expand our solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to join the company as a Senior Manager for our Technical Services and ongoing support (TSOS) team. You will take on a pivotal role in advancing the technical support of our products globally, lead an experienced team of technical services specialists and develop, drive and execute the service strategy for the digital business, reporting directly to the Global Director of Customer Success. You'll be a part of a Global team within Customer Success, and a key partner to sales, product and engineering teams.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Define and execute the global technical support strategy, aligned with the Business growth, enterprise strategy, customer needs and product evolution. </li><li>Oversee support operations across multiple global markets. </li><li>Lead, expand and continue to develop a global team of TSOS specialists. </li><li>Maintain and develop KPIs, SLAs and escalation frameworks to ensure fast, effective resolution of customer issues while assisting in managing ticket escalations and prioritisation and communication of risks to the business. </li><li>Ensure consistent support standards across regions while adapting to local market requirements. </li><li>Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the Touch Surgery Ecosystem and build working relationships with internal product and engineering teams to ensure real-world client feedback is incorporated into product development.   </li><li>Drive adoption and optimisation of support tools, processes and documentation. </li><li>Work with Quality/Regulatory teams to ensure compliance with medical device standards and reporting obligations. </li><li>Introduce automation and AI-based support enhancements where possible and cost effective. <br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Required Knowledge and Experience:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree required. </li><li>Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience with 5+ years of managerial experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience with 5+ years of managerial experience.</li><li>Extended experience in supporting medical devices. </li><li>Business acumen and strategic mindset - track record of successfully driving service strategy. </li><li>Familiar with service software platforms and experience with service data integration. </li><li>Ability to communicate and influence effectively across multiple teams. </li><li>Strong project management skills. </li><li>Ability to work from the London office for at least 2 to 3 days per week.</li><li>Willingness to work flexible hours to support collaboration across different regions and time zones.</li><li>Willingness to travel approximately 10–15% of the time, depending on project needs.<br><br><br></li></ul>Experience working with connected devices, digital solutions, and/or video streaming is preferred, along with a background in digital healthcare.<br><br><strong>Physical Job Requirements<br><br></strong>The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. <br><br><strong>Benefits &amp; Compensation<br><br></strong><strong>Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package<br><br></strong>A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.<br><br>This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).<br><br><strong>About Medtronic<br><br></strong>We lead global healthcare technology and boldly attack the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions.<br><br>Our Mission — to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life — unites a global team of 95,000+ passionate people.<br><br>We are engineers at heart— putting ambitious ideas to work to generate real solutions for real people. From the R&amp;D lab, to the factory floor, to the conference room, every one of us experiments, creates, builds, improves and solves. We have the talent, diverse perspectives, and guts to engineer the extraordinary.<br><br>Learn more about our business, mission, and our commitment to diversity here

title: Senior Sales Director, Media & Communications
description: <strong>Overview<br><br></strong>The Media &amp; Communications ATU Lead is a senior sales leadership role responsible for Microsoft’s business across communications and media accounts—including telecommunications providers, broadcasters, publishers, advertising firms, and other media/entertainment/sports companies. This position represents a significant market growth opportunity to elevate a strong-performing business unit and requires a leader who can drive strategic engagement, inspire teams, and deliver business outcomes in a dynamic sector.<br><br>In this role, you will own Microsoft’s sales strategy for the Media &amp; Communications (Telco) industry, oversee a team including people managers, account executives and account technology strategists (account CTO’s), and ensure that the very best of Microsoft’s technology solutions are being delivered to help our customers in achieving their business objectives. You will act as the executive sponsor for key client relationships, with regular engagement at the CxO level to co-develop innovative digital transformation opportunities. Equally important, you will lead as a “people-first” manager, fostering an inclusive and supportive team culture where your sales teams are inspired to excel and feel valued, especially as they navigate recent changes in structure and leadership.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li> Customer &amp; Partner Obsession</li><li>Coach account teams to develop C-level and Line of Business relationships across all relevant stakeholders.</li><li>Drive year-over-year improvement in customer experience, satisfaction, and relationship momentum across industry, customer, and partner landscapes.</li><li>Lead and empower account teams to deliver customer business outcomes, engaging as One Microsoft through quality Account Plans and Customer Secure AI Assessments.</li><li>Co-sell with partners through joint customer planning and execution.</li><li> Sales Leadership &amp; Business Excellence</li><li>Own the sales strategy and execution for the Media &amp; Communications sector, setting vision and priorities for Microsoft’s engagement.</li><li>Drive new business growth, ensuring sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to meet quarterly and annual targets.</li><li>Execute timely renewals and drive upsell and new business through rigorous mid-term selling motions.</li><li>Foster a culture of always-on selling for consumption and usage across all solution areas.</li><li>Ensure robust business management, including accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and compliance with Microsoft’s ethical sales standards.</li><li> People &amp; Change Leadership</li><li>Model a learn-it-all culture by developing skills in AI, security, industry, executive engagement, coaching, and change management.</li><li>Lead the team through organisational evolution &amp; change, ensuring successful transitions to new go-to-market and engagement models.</li><li>Coach and develop talent, focusing on hiring, retaining, and growing key team members to meet industry and customer needs.</li><li>Foster a collaborative, high-morale team culture, investing in employee growth through coaching and mentorship.</li><li> Compliance</li><li>Personally commit to generating and protecting Microsoft trust by living Microsoft’s values, culture, and Trust Code in every decision.</li><li>Ensure team adherence to policies and processes, with 100% completion of required compliance training.</li><li>Proactively identify and escalate risks, supporting controls, review processes, and investigations as needed.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Serve as the industry thought leader for media and communications within Microsoft, monitoring industry evolution and proactively identifying how Microsoft’s offerings address emerging trends.</li><li>Engage deeply with C-suite and senior executives at client organisations, building trust and co-creating new business opportunities aligned with Microsoft technology.</li><li>Lead the Media &amp; Comms ATU sales team as a second-line leader, instilling a shared sense of mission and clarity of roles to sales managers, account directors and account technology strategists (CTO’s)</li><li>Orchestrate a One Microsoft approach, coordinating across specialist sales, customer success, engineering, support, consulting, and partner teams to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet client needs.</li><li>Liaise with product groups and leadership to advocate for customer needs and engage Microsoft’s partner ecosystem to extend reach and value proposition.</li><li>Conduct regular business reviews, analyse performance metrics, and make data-driven decisions to keep the business on track.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><strong>Required Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience in enterprise technology sales leadership, including roles as a sales manager or director overseeing account teams in a complex organisation.</li><li>Significant experience in the Communications and/or Media industry, with credibility and insight into industry-specific challenges.</li><li>Proven history of engaging and influencing C-level executives and senior business decision-makers.</li><li>Experience in people management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead managers and teams to high performance.</li><li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degree (MBA or similar) is a plus.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience driving innovative solutions in the media/telecom space and a track record of solution selling.</li><li>Familiarity with Microsoft’s cloud and enterprise offerings or experience with large enterprise software platforms in a media or communications context.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to lead organisations through change, unite teams around new strategies, and drive culture change.</li><li>Established network in the media and/or telecom industry.</li><li>Passion for technology and its transformative impact on media and communications.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Measures of Success<br><br></strong><ul><li>Completion rates and quality of Account/Customer plans and Secure AI assessments.</li><li>Expansion of C-suite engagement and improved customer satisfaction scores.</li><li>Achievement of pipeline coverage, renewal and consumption targets measured by the revenue based incentive scheme.</li><li>Team development, retention, and completion of required skilling.</li><li>Being recognised as an elevated industry growing ahead of the industry and sub average growth rate.</li><li>Adherence to compliance standards and proactive risk management.<br><br></li></ul>This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.<br><br>Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about <strong>requesting accommodations.</strong>

title: Global Platform Team Lead and Senior Director - IT Security
description: <strong>Locations</strong>: Boston | Atlanta | London<br><br>Who We Are<br><br>Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.<br><br>To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.<br><br>What You'll Do<br><br>The Global Platform Team Lead and Senior Director - IT Security is responsible for leading the design, delivery, and continuous evolution of BCG's security platforms across identity, device, and data protection domains. This role ensures end-to-end security engineering across all technology environments, including cloud, on-prem, and hybrid systems. The leader will drive strategic planning, execution, and operations of scalable, automated, and resilient security controls that protect BCG’s global operations and users, while enabling innovation and agility across BCG Core, BCG X, and CT worldwide. This role is also accountable for embedding security within DevSecOps practices, enforcing automation at scale, and applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across all security services.<br><br>The role requires strong partnership with ISRM, with a focus on balancing and prioritizing security requirements, automation opportunities, user experience needs, and broader business outcomes.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Strategic Leadership &amp; Transformation:</li><ul><li>Define and execute a unified security engineering strategy that addresses identity, endpoint, and data protection across all environments.</li><li>Lead the design and implementation of scalable, automated security solutions that integrate seamlessly into enterprise platforms and user experiences.</li><li>Establish a global security architecture and engineering roadmap focused on prevention, detection, and rapid response.</li><li>Drive continuous improvement of security posture while aligning with business needs, regulatory requirements, and user experience expectations.</li><li>Champion DevSecOps practices to embed security early into development and delivery workflows.</li></ul><li>Security Platform Engineering:</li><ul><li>Lead end-to-end engineering for identity and access management (IAM), including authentication, authorization, and privileged access controls.</li><li>Oversee endpoint security architecture and enforcement, ensuring comprehensive coverage for threat detection, malware prevention, and device compliance.</li><li>Build and operate scalable data protection solutions, including data loss prevention (DLP), secrets management, encryption, and classification.</li><li>Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native services, and on-prem platforms to enforce security-by-design principles.</li><li>Deliver security capabilities that support modern work scenarios, remote access, zero-trust networking, and AI/ML workloads.</li><li>Leverage automation frameworks and IaC to improve scalability and reduce manual intervention.</li></ul><li>Operational Security, SRE &amp; Assurance:</li><ul><li>Ensure security platforms are resilient, continuously monitored, and designed for 24x7 support and incident response readiness.</li><li>Embed security telemetry and observability to enable proactive threat detection and automated response.</li><li>Apply SRE principles to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability of security services.</li><li>Lead platform health, patching automation, and vulnerability remediation workflows.</li><li>Define service level objectives (SLOs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) for all security services.</li></ul><li>Compliance, Governance &amp; Risk Management:</li><ul><li>Ensure alignment with global compliance requirements such as ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, GDPR, and others.</li><li>Partner with governance, legal, and ISRM teams to implement enforceable policies and standards across identity, endpoint, and data domains.</li><li>Operationalize policy enforcement through automated controls and continuous compliance checks.</li><li>Lead risk mitigation efforts with technical solutions that scale across diverse user and system profiles.</li></ul><li>Financial &amp; Vendor Management:</li><ul><li>Manage security platform budgets and investments with a focus on cost optimization and long-term value.</li><li>Evaluate and manage third-party vendors and partners, ensuring they meet technical, contractual, and security expectations.</li><li>Lead procurement and renewal cycles in alignment with operational and architectural strategies.</li></ul><li>Leadership &amp; Talent Development:</li><ul><li>Build and mentor a global team of security engineers, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and forward-thinking culture.</li><li>Drive internal knowledge sharing and upskilling programs across security architecture, automation, and secure software engineering.</li><li>Collaborate cross-functionally with platform, product, and enterprise architecture teams to embed security early and often.<br></li></ul></ul>What You'll Bring<br><br><strong>Required Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, or platform security roles.</li><li>5+ years in a senior leadership position with accountability for enterprise-scale security platforms.</li><li>Deep expertise in IAM, endpoint security, and data protection technologies, with proven ability to design and scale global solutions.</li><li>Experience with security engineering in hybrid and cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li><li>Proven track record in automating security controls, implementing zero-trust models, and supporting 24x7 security operations.</li><li>Strong understanding of compliance frameworks and risk management strategies.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, or equivalent.</li><li>Experience with tools like Okta, Azure AD, CrowdStrike, Tanium, Zscaler, Vault, and other modern security platforms.</li><li>Familiarity with DevSecOps principles, Infrastructure as Code, and secure software development practices.<br><br></li></ul>Who You'll Work With<br><br><strong>Work Environment &amp; Additional Information<br><br></strong><ul><li>Hybrid or on-site work model.</li><li>Occasional travel may be required for business, vendor, or team engagement.</li><li>Ability to operate in a fast-paced, complex environment, balancing long-term strategy with operational agility.<br><br></li></ul>Additional info<br><br>*** For US locations only ***<br><br>In the US, we have a compensation transparency approach.<br><br>Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, retirement contribution, and a market leading benefits package described below.<br><br><ul><li>The base salary range for this role in Boston is $183,000.00 - $237,000.00.<br><br></li></ul>This is an estimated range, however, specific base salaries within the range depend on various factors such as experience and skill set. It is not common for new BCG employees to be hired at the high-end of the salary range. BCG regularly reviews its ranges to ensure market competitiveness.<br><br>In addition to your base salary, your total compensation will include a bonus of up to 45% and a generous retirement contribution that starts at 10%. Senior Directors/Executive Directors are also eligible for a Firm Performance Bonus.<br><br><strong>All Of Our Plans Provide Best In Class Coverage<br><br></strong><ul><li>Zero dollar ($0) health insurance premiums for BCG employees, spouses, and children</li><li>Low $10 (USD) copays for trips to the doctor, urgent care visits and prescriptions for generic drugs</li><li>Dental coverage, including up to $5,000 in orthodontia benefits</li><li>Vision insurance with coverage for both glasses and contact lenses annually</li><li>Reimbursement for gym memberships and other fitness activities</li><li>Fully vested Profit Sharing Retirement Fund contributions made annually, whether you contribute or not, plus the option for employees to make personal contributions to a 401(k) plan</li><li>Paid Parental Leave and other family benefits such as elective egg freezing, surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement</li><li>Generous paid time off including 12 holidays per year, an annual office closure between Christmas and New Years, and 20 vacation days per year (earned at 1.66 days per month)</li><li>Paid sick time on an as needed basis<br><br></li></ul>Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.<br><br>BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here  for more information on E-Verify.
